environment.description: ECS Fargate task (platform version 1.4.0) with the following configuration: (1) Container image built with AWS Graviton3 (ARM64) base using al2023-minimal, compiled with '-fstack-protector-strong -fstack-clash-protection -pie -Wl,-z,relro,-z,now -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=2'. (2) Task definition specifies linuxParameters.initProcessEnabled=true with a custom seccomp profile loaded via ECS agent configuration that restricts syscalls to a whitelist excluding execve, execveat, and mprotect with PROT_EXEC. (3) The Fargate platform version 1.4.0 ENI is placed in a private subnet with security group sg-0a1b2c3d4e5f that only allows inbound from the internal ALB (sg-9f8e7d6c5b4a). (4) AWS CloudHSM cluster hsm-cluster-abc123 configured with quorum authentication (m-of-n with m=2) for key management operations, though single-party encrypt operations are permitted for the service's CU (crypto user). The HSM audit logs stream to CloudWatch with metric filter alarms on anomalous request patterns exceeding 100 encrypt calls per second per session_id.

config.network: private subnet, ALB-only ingress via sg-0a1b2c3d4e5f
config.alb_config: internal ALB with connection draining, max request size 8KB
config.hsm_cluster: hsm-cluster-abc123 with quorum auth for key mgmt
config.monitoring: CloudWatch metric filter on encrypt rate per session_id
